tracks.prompt: Instrumental pastoral chamber-folk background music, warm and gently optimistic at about 74 BPM. Felt piano melodies, delicate nylon-string plucks, soft sustained strings and rounded bass, with subtle harmonic turns and new phrases across nearly four minutes; spacious, restrained dynamics, no drums or vocals.

Instrumental reflective ambient chamber music, quiet and contemplative at about 68 BPM. Sparse felt piano, soft bell counterpoint, airy strings and a warm low pad; melodic motifs evolve through several gentle sections with pauses and resolution across nearly four minutes, no beat-heavy drums or vocals.

Instrumental restrained tension music for a thoughtful strategy game, steady at about 88 BPM. Muted piano figures, low string pulses, soft mallet percussion and discreet synth bass in minor-modal harmony; gradual rises and releases across nearly four minutes, never bombastic, no sharp impacts or vocals.
